channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Holds within 94–96 range against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank notes that USD/INR eased 0.2% on Friday to 95.20 but still gained 0.9% over the week, remaining within a 94–96 range.

item.title: Analysts agree: Oil prices likely to fall further even after returning to pre-war levels
item.description: Brent Crude Oil trade flat near $71.90 during the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar stabilizes after long weekend
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Monday, July 6:

item.title: Australian Dollar: Downside bias within broader neutral band against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang reports AUD/USD has stalled after last week’s sharp rise, with a tentative build-up in downside momentum pointing to a limited dip toward 0.6910 intraday. For the next 1–3 weeks, the bank stays neutral, expecting consolidation between 0.6870 and 0.6980.

item.title: Oil: Diverging market paths under geopolitical camps – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Senior Market Strategist Benjamin Picton highlights that Brent has turned lower as OPEC+ eases production cuts and tanker flows through the Strait of Hormuz resume, but stresses that shipping risks remain crucial for Oil prices.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar: RBNZ set for further tightening – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu expects the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) to raise the Official Cash Rate (OCR) by 25bp to 2.50%, supported by stronger Gross Domestic Product (GDP), resilient labor markets and firm inflation near the top of target.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Retakes 1.4200 and beyond as bulls await trading range breakout
item.description: The USD/CAD pair is seen building on last week's bounce from the vicinity of mid-1.4100s and gaining positive traction for the second consecutive day on Monday.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Eyes 40-year highs near 163.00 after breaking above nine-day EMA
item.description: USD/JPY gains ground for the second successive day, trading around 162.20 during the early European hours on Monday. The currency pair is maintaining a bullish near-term bias as it holds comfortably above both the nine-day and 50-day Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: US Dollar Index: Upside risks stay supported – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner notes the Dollar (USD) has held up after soft June jobs data, with G7 FX volatility low and carry trades attractive as one-week Dollar deposit rates sit in the upper G10 range.

item.title: Indian Rupee declines against US Dollar at the start of FOMC Minutes week
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades lower against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week.

item.title: Equities: Risk tone improves with dovish repricing – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists note that the S&P 500 delivered its strongest weekly gain since early May, supported by a softer US payrolls print and a dovish repricing of Fed expectations.

item.title: Gold sticks to modest losses as Hormuz risks bolster USD; lacks bearish conviction
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) shows some resilience below the $4,150 level and, for now, seems to have stalled its intraday retracement slide from a two-week high, levels just above the $4,200 mark, touched earlier this Monday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention risks shape Dollar pullback – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Teppei Ino reviews recent USD/JPY price action, noting the pair opened near 161.78 and briefly tested the 162.84 area before reversing. The report highlights Dollar weakness after comments from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh and a softer US employment report.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Pound dips below 1.3350 with bullish momentum losing steam
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) ticks lower against the US Dollar (USD) Monday, attempting to close a seven-day rally, as tensions rise again in the Strait of Hormuz, one of the critical points in the peace process between Washington and Tehran.

item.title: Swiss Franc declines as US Dollar rebounds, eyes on US Services PMI
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) faces selling pressure against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/CHF pair is down 0.25% to near 0.8055 during the European trading session as the US Dollar rebounds despite traders reconsidering Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hike expectations.

item.title: British Pound: Overbought rally still eyeing 1.3410 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes GBP/USD remains elevated after last week’s surge, with scope for a modest pullback confined to 1.3320–1.3375 intraday and limited risk of a clear break below 1.3320.

item.title: Euro: ECB support offsets Dollar strength – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister argues that recent EUR/USD weakness reflects a stronger US Dollar (USD) rather than a fundamentally weak Euro (EUR), as the Euro has outperformed the G10 average.

item.title: Germany Factory Orders rises 1.9% in May, beats 1.2% estimates
item.description: Germany's Factory Orders jumps 1.9% in May, faster than 1.2% estimates, according to the official data published by the Federal Statistics Office on Monday. In April, the economic data was declined by 3.2%, revised higher from -3.8%.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: 20-day EMA acts as key barrier near 1.1460
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades marginally lower to near 1.1428 during the early European trading session on Monday. The major currency pair faces slight selling pressure as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground after a negative weekly close.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah weakens as Fed hike bets lift US Dollar
item.description: USD/IDR rises for the second successive day, trading around 18,040 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar receives support from prevailing market expectations of Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hikes later this year.

item.title: United States Dollar Index rises to near 101.00 on Fed hikes this year
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is gaining ground after remaining unchanged in the previous day and trading around 101.00 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Japanese Yen declines towards 162.00 vs USD as carry trades counter intervention risks
item.description: The USD/JPY pair builds on its goodish recovery from the 160.50-160.45 region, or over a two-week low touched on Friday, and gains strong follow-through traction for the second straight day on Monday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Tests 185.00 after breaking above moving averages
item.description: EUR/JPY gains ground for the second successive day, trading around 185.00 during the Asian hours on Monday. The currency cross holds a constructive near-term bias as it trades above the nine-period and 50-period Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Retreats from 38.2% Fibo. hurdle; holds above 0.6900
item.description: The AUD/USD pair meets with a fresh supply during the Asian session on Monday and, for now, seems to have snapped a two-day winning streak to the 0.6950 region, or a one-and-a-half-week high touched on Friday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD corrects to near $62, increasing bearish bets on oil prices limit downside
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is down 1% to near $61.80 during the Asian trading session on Monday. The white metal falls back after rising for four straight trading days.

item.title: Canadian Dollar weakens despite higher oil prices
item.description: USD/CAD gains ground for the second consecutive day, trading around 1.4210 during the Asian hours on Monday. The upside of the pair could be restrained as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) could receive support from higher oil prices.

item.title: WTI rises to near $69.00 despite OPEC+ hikes, Hormuz flows
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around $69.00 per barrel during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: ECB’s Moulin: Central bank is in a “good position” after raising interest rates in June
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Emmanuel Moulin said at the Rencontres Economiques conference in Aix-en-Provence on Saturday that the central bank is in a “good position” after raising interest rates in its June policy meeting, with inflation easing alongside the slump in oil pr

item.title: OPEC+ agrees on raising output targets, starting in August
item.description: The Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries and its allies (OPEC+), including Russia, agreed to raise their output targets by 188,000 barrels a day starting in August.
